title: Drop unreferenced phase2 bundles from the APK
body:
## Summary
APK 74,062,061 B to 41,410,447 B (-32.65 MB, -44%).
## Description
phase2-v1, phase2-hud, phase2-fusion are read only by desktop audits and tests from ../assets; runtime loads phase2-states, story-art, regions, audio.
## Flow
androidResources.ignoreAssetsPattern in app/build.gradle.kts.
## Expected impact
Smaller install and faster adb push.
## Evaluation
Claim: bundles unused at runtime. Before: 74,062,061 B. After: 41,410,447 B. Method: assembleDebug + unzip -l. Result: better. Gate: core/link/game tests + assembleDebug.
evidence: unzip -l before/after; grep of Gradle/Kotlin runtime roots

title: Drop x86_64 ABI from release builds
body:
## Summary
x86_64 natives and jniLibs are about 193 KB of the APK; Fire TV is arm only.
## Description
Emulator users need x86_64, so gate it on a property.
## Flow
abiFilters conditional on -PemulatorAbi.
## Expected impact
~0.19 MB.
## Evaluation
Claim: tiny gain. Before 193 KB. After 0. Method: unzip. Result: unmeasured on device. Gate: owner decides on emulator use.

title: Release minify/R8 and resource shrink
body:
## Summary
Only the debug APK exists; classes*.dex total ~16.7 MB.
## Description
Add release buildType with R8 and keep rules for libGDX reflection and the link server; debug unchanged.
## Flow
Release only.
## Expected impact
Maybe 5-8 MB dex reduction; unmeasured.
## Evaluation
Claim: dex shrink. Before 16.7 MB dex. After: not built. Method: assembleRelease. Result: pending. Gate: smoke on device.

title: Gradle configuration cache
body:
## Summary
org.gradle.configuration-cache not enabled; AGP plus custom extractNatives task with copy{} in doLast is a cache hazard.
## Description
Needs extractNatives rewritten as a typed Sync task before enabling.
## Flow
Convert task, enable flag, time up-to-date run.
## Expected impact
Seconds per invocation; unmeasured.
## Evaluation
Claim: faster config. Before: not measured. After: n/a. Method: two consecutive no-op runs. Result: pending. Gate: tests green.

Disposition 2026-10-07 (optimize-ledger pass, no build): declined, saving under the 5 s bar. Measured on the gate (:core:test :link:test :game:test, all 15 tasks up-to-date, warm daemon, wall clock): plain 1,922 / 1,914 ms; with --configuration-cache --configuration-cache-problems=warn 1,286 / 1,276 ms (entry stored on the first run, reused on both timed runs). Saving about 0.64 s per gate run. Problems reported: none for the gate's task graph. extractNatives (app/build.gradle.kts:39) is not in that graph, so the cache hazard the card expects was not exercised; it would only show on :app tasks. No build file or gradle.properties changed.

title: Recompress story-art and phase2-states PNGs losslessly
body:
## Summary
phase2-states is 16 MB of PNG; zopfli/oxipng could save 5-15% with identical pixels.
## Description
Needs a pixel-diff harness; ETC/KTX would change visuals and is out of scope.
## Flow
oxipng -o4 plus per-pixel compare before commit.
## Expected impact
~1-2 MB APK; no runtime texture memory change.
## Evaluation
Claim: lossless smaller. Before 16.07 MB. After: not run (tool unavailable). Method: pixel diff. Result: pending. Gate: art-states-gl audit.

title: Repo bloat: evidence/ is 1.0 GB and art/ 324 MB
body:
## Summary
Report only; evidence is tracked and not packaged in the APK.
## Description
Candidate for LFS or archive branch; do not delete tracked evidence.
## Flow
Owner decision.
## Expected impact
Clone size.
## Evaluation
Claim: repo bloat. Before 1.03 GB working copy. After n/a. Method: du. Result: reported. Gate: owner.

Disposition 2026-10-07: built, by the operator's ruling of 2026-10-07 'Summaries in git, raw outside' (229613b1 moved raw evidence out, 8996e1ac added the EvidenceRuleTest guard). Ruling figure: 994.2 MiB in 6,354 files under deathride/evidence/ at 20189c47. Re-measured with git ls-tree -r -l at b365b4e5: deathride/evidence/ 996.2 MiB in 6,523 files (+2.0 MiB, +169 files of post-ruling summaries, each under the 512 KiB cap); deathride/art/ 303.4 MiB in 4,475 files. History keeps the grandfathered files; the guard stops new raw ones.
